headline: Agents Navigate the Web by Reference
lede: A Rust-native browser CLI gives autonomous systems a compact accessibility tree instead of a sprawling DOM. Persistent sessions, stable element references, and DevTools control turn real websites into a programmable operating surface.

headline: Security Audits Gain an Adversarial Second Pass
lede: This coding-agent skill divides reconnaissance, vulnerability hunting, and verification into six accountable phases. Structured JSON ledgers separate confirmed flaws from unresolved leads, demanding evidence before an alert becomes a finding.

headline: Google Packages Cloud Expertise for Agents
lede: Google’s skills catalog gives agents reusable procedures for IAM, GKE, databases, networking, observability, and security. Teams can install targeted guidance, refresh it centrally, and move from onboarding to production diagnosis with less reinvention.

headline: Engineering Discipline Enters the Agent Loop
lede: Matt Pocock’s modular skills bring TDD, domain modeling, and requirement alignment into everyday coding-agent sessions. With more than 317,000 stars, the collection signals a large appetite for faster automation that still respects software fundamentals.

headline: Anthropic Opens a Cabinet of Agent Skills
lede: Each self-contained package combines metadata, operating instructions, examples, and supporting scripts for work ranging from documents to software development. The repository also preserves the specification and starter template needed to author compatible skills of your own.

headline: Astryx Brings Meta’s Components Into the Open
lede: Astryx offers more than 150 accessible React components, themes, templates, and dark-mode patterns for React 19 and StyleX. Typed APIs, CSS variable theming, and an ejectable CLI let teams start polished and customize without surrendering control.

headline: Prometheus Turns Operations Into Queryable Time
lede: Prometheus pulls labeled metrics from changing infrastructure, then exposes system behavior through PromQL, recording rules, and alerts. Service discovery keeps the stream connected as targets move across cloud-native environments.

headline: Sherlock Maps a Username Across the Public Web
lede: This practical Python CLI checks hundreds of services for a supplied handle using site-specific patterns and response tests. Filters, exports, proxies, and batch inputs make identity reconnaissance repeatable from the terminal.

headline: OpenMausBot Keeps an Agent Team Close
lede: OpenMausBot coordinates specialized agents, transcripts, credentials, and connected applications from a local-first control plane. A permission broker gates shell commands and file changes, giving automation room to work without making trust implicit.

headline: Ruff Makes Python Hygiene Nearly Instant
lede: Written in Rust, Ruff consolidates linting, formatting, import sorting, and more than 900 rules into one fast toolchain. Caching, native fixes, and monorepo-aware configuration move code quality checks from a slow ritual into the build’s critical path.
